mapper.select: SELECT * FROM blossom_plan WHERE plan_date = CURDATE() AND plan_start_time >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE), '%H:%i') AND plan_start_time < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 MINUTE), '%H:%i');

SELECT * FROM blossom_todo WHERE todo_id = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') AND task_status != 'COMPLETED' AND start_time < DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 35 MINUTE) AND start_time >= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MINUTE)
